lede: Historic Yorktown does Christmas along the York River, with a tree lighting at the Victory Monument, a lighted boat parade and Santa events at Riverwalk Landing.
celebrates: Yorktown opens its holiday season with the Christmas Tree Lighting on Friday, December 4. Families gather at the Victory Monument at 6:30 pm for live holiday music, including The Fifes and Drums of York Town, then follow a procession to Riverwalk Landing for the lighting of a 24 foot tree at 7:30 pm, with Santa and Mrs. Claus on hand. The next evening, boats set sail at 7 pm for the Lighted Boat Parade while the Boy Scouts of America serve hot cider. Santa shows up again for Cookies with Santa at York Hall, Breakfast with Santa at Riverwalk Restaurant and the Toyland Parade. York County Parks, Recreation and Tourism and Visit Yorktown list the events.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap with attendance or highlights for Yorktown's holiday events, so the 2026 listings on this page come straight from Visit Yorktown, York County and the host websites. WYDaily's 2026 preview says Santa arrives in true Yorktown fashion, aboard a vintage fire truck, before greeting families. Check each host page for current times and parking before you go.
facts: WYDaily says Yorktown's Christmas Tree Lighting dates back to 1945. Local elementary school children perform holiday favorites at the Victory Monument before the procession to Riverwalk Landing. The tree is a 24 foot Tannenbaum. This page also lists a few nearby events from Poquoson and Gloucester, since those towns do not have their own pages.
trains: Yorktown does not have a train museum of its own. Our guide to train museums in Virginia lists 17 museums with hours and rides, so you can plan a train outing near the Peninsula. The Williamsburg Christmas Market also offers a train ride, listed on our Williamsburg page, and the Port Warwick tree lighting in Newport News has train rides on November 28.
